items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: And I did a three hour interview for Phil Schaap on WKCR.

ctx.x: Yes. How did you know that? Well you should know that. And Allen Eager. And what happened was the gig became a fiasco, I hate to say this, but because of Allen Eager. Because he was like a negative personality. Because Kai would say “hey what are we going to play? How about —” And the guys were making suggestions. Like why don’t we play this, why don’t we play this. Everything was said, Allen would say “no man, don’t play that.” So we tried to please him and say “all right we’ll play that.” Nobody really wanted…
Well it’s interesting that a lot of recording at that time must have been pretty much off the cuff. You get the musicians together and then you decide what you’re going to play.
